about: Sealed roaming records (#759 S2). One fixed key and nonce so every byte is reproducible; a real writer draws a fresh random nonce per seal. Replayed by pwa/test/unit/roaming-records.test.mjs.

valid.name: an order with pins, a group, a tombstoned group, a deleted row and a membership with no row

converge.name: rename against delete of a group: the delete is newer, so the session falls back to Sessions
rename against delete of a group: the rename is newer, so the group stays

refused.name: the kind byte says marker in an order slot
a generation this device holds no key for
a record moved to another order id
a record moved to another account
trailing padding that is not zero
a length prefix past the padded body
a device tag that is not 32 lowercase hex
a register naming a device past the table
an entry with neither position nor membership
a schema 2 body that is otherwise valid
